question: o07
q: How many Argentine pesos does one Australian dollar buy?

transcript.answer:
I can't give you that rate. My exchange-rate sources don't include the Argentine peso. The RBA publishes rates for about 20 other currencies, but not ARS, and I don't have another source for it.

For a current peso rate, try the Banco Central de la República Argentina (BCRA) website, or a live converter such as XE or Google Finance. Argentina has had several official and parallel (blue-dollar) rates, so check which one you need.

What I can confirm is the Australian dollar against the US dollar. In October 2026 (last monthly observation, 2026-10), A$1 bought US$0.6947. If you have a peso-to-US-dollar rate, you can multiply it by 0.6947 to get the approximate peso value of A$1, but the result depends on which peso rate you use.
